messages:
maria-support: FYI, acme is getting 429s since ~08:00 UTC. They say console shows their API key has 0 usage for today. Ticket #12345 with request ids pasted. Any quick checks?
ben-sre: Can you paste a sample request id + the customer org_id? need to correlate enforcement logs.
maria-support: org_id: acme-42, sample req: req_2026_08_07_ab12. From customer curl: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> 429.
maria-support: Ticket includes enforcement log snippet: `2026-08-07T08:02:11Z enforcement-service[svc-5] WARN req=req_2026_08_07_ab12 key_hash=abc123 code=429 reason=rate_limit_exceeded remaining=0`
charlie-eng: Interesting — enforcement shows remaining=0 which matches 429s, but you said console usage table is empty?
maria-support: Yes console -> Analytics -> Usage for acme-42 shows 0 tokens and no rows for the day.
ben-sre: That suggests usage events are not being ingested into the metrics pipeline. Possible causes: consumer lag, dropped events due to schema mismatch, or key-stripping before publish.
charlie-eng: Reproducer from my side to confirm enforcement path: `while true; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxx' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate; sleep 0.5; done` -> returns 429 after ~10 requests. Matching enforcement logs.
sam-sre: I checked kafka offsets for topic `usage-raw-events`: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --group usage-ingress-consumer --describe` shows consumer lag=0 and committed offset ~842345.
charlie-eng: Can you tail the ingress consumer logs? `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/usage-ingress-consumer -c consumer --since=2h | tail -n 200`
charlie-eng: From ingress logs yesterday I see repeated drop reasons: `WARN drop event missing(api_key) trace_id=...` and also `ERROR parse failed: schema_v2 != schema_v1` around the deployment window.
maria-support: Deploy-bot shows a rollout at 07:50 UTC: `deploy-bot: rollout usage-ingest v2.3.1 -> 2.4.0 started by charlie-eng`
deploy-bot: usage-ingest v2.4.0 successfully deployed at 07:54 UTC (canary 5% -> 100% by 07:58).
ben-sre: That lines up. If v2.4 changed the required field name (api_key -> client_key) we'd drop events without api_key, leaving enforcement to still use the live token bucket state (which is persisted in the enforcement store) and causing 429s, while console shows no events.
charlie-eng: Quick check against raw topic: `kafka-console-consumer --topic usage-raw-events --from-beginning --max-messages 50 | jq '.api_key' | sort | uniq -c` shows many `null` after 07:50.
charlie-eng: Also saw this in ingress logs: `INFO received event {"client_key": "sk-xxx", "tokens": 120} but schema expects api_key`
lina-product: If ingestion is dropping keys, the analytics UI will show nothing and our billing/alerts will be off. We need to prioritize rollback if that's the root cause.
ben-sre: Short term fix: rollback usage-ingest to v2.3.1 and re-run a replay of the raw topic for the dropped window. Long term: add a schema compatibility check + test to CI and alert on increases in dropped event counts.
charlie-eng: Action items: 1) sam-sre to rollback canary -> full rollback (if needed). 2) sam-sre to run consumer replay for time window 07:50-08:10. 3) charlie to add compatibility guard and a one-line migration.
sam-sre: Rolling back now. `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/usage-ingest usage-ingest=usage-ingest:v2.3.1`
sam-sre: Rollback complete at 08:12 UTC. Monitoring ingress logs for recovered `api_key` field.
charlie-eng: Starting replay: `kafka-consumer-replay --topic usage-raw-events --from 842300 --to 842380 --target-topic usage-processed` (monitoring for duplicate handling).
charlie-eng: Quick sanity check after replay: console shows ingestion events for acme-42 from 07:50-08:05; usage counts jumping.
maria-support: Customer reports 429s stopped ~08:15 and says usage numbers now show up in the Console. They want postmortem + compensation asks.
lina-product: We'll draft a short customer note and confirm if any billing/cost adjustments are needed. Also schedule a postmortem runbook.
ben-sre: Root cause: backward-incompatible change in usage-ingest v2.4.0 that dropped api_key field. Fixes: rollback + replay, schema CI, alert for dropped-event-rate, add end-to-end smoke of analytics pipeline on deploy.
charlie-eng: I'll open a postmortem PR with timeline & remediation.
maria-support: Thanks everyone, marking ticket #12345 as awaiting postmortem and customer comms. :thumbsup:
